title: The Legend of Tarzan (TV series)
production_companies: Walt Disney Television AnimationAnimation outsourced to Walt Disney Animation Australia
The Hana Animation Company and Jade Animation.
premise_summary: The Legend of Tarzan is an American animated television series produced by Walt Disney Television Animation, based on Tarzan from the novels written by Edgar Rice Burroughs, the character's original creator who appears in one episode of the series. The series is also based on Disney's 1999 animated feature film Tarzan by Walt Disney Pictures and aired initially on the Disney's One Too block on UPN from September 3, 2001 to February 5, 2003. However, reruns were broadcast shortly after on Toon Disney.
